headline: Oana Gheorghiu on Salary Law: Two-Thirds of Public Sector Employees Would Have Earned More. PSD Sabotaged the Political Agreement
summary: Deputy Prime Minister Oana Gheorghiu accused PSD of blocking a political agreement on public sector salary reform. She said Romania risks losing €770 million from the PNRR recovery plan.
why: The PNRR is Romania's EU-funded recovery plan, and delays in meeting its milestones can cost the country grant money. Public wage policy also affects the government's budget and fiscal outlook.
